data.description: There are complex use conditions for using materials associated with this record. Before loans are begun, a collection should carefully review paperwork, permits, agreements, etc. to determine whether a loan can be made. Examples include materials from CITES-listed species, marine mammals, migratory birds, etc.
There are no use conditions on any of the materials associated with the records beyond standard accession and loan terms set by the holding institution.

In order to use materials associated with this record, the loaning institution must get approval from a third party (i.e., the material donor) and/or loan recipients must provide attribution to a third party (i.e., not the loaning institution) in order to receive and/or use the materials. This approval and attribution is above and beyond the standard accession and loan terms set by the loaning institution.

metadata.label: Permit Metadata: Use Conditions
metadata.description: Concise generalized summary of use conditions imposed by a permit. Multiple values should be joined with semicolons (Example: "attribution; notification").
